result.one_liner: Twilio is a cloud communications platform enabling developers to send SMS, make voice calls, and manage messaging across multiple channels via APIs.

evidence.quote: HTTP Basic authentication for authenticating requests to the Twilio APIs, using your API key SID as the username and your API key secret as the password
API keys are the preferred way to authenticate with Twilio's REST APIs
Access Tokens are short-lived tokens that you use to authenticate Twilio client-side SDKs
No credit card is required to start and you only pay for what you use
Your Twilio trial account uses the same account credentials that you use after you upgrade, with no separate trial-only credentials
The Twilio Model Context Protocol (MCP) server gives AI coding agents direct, structured access to Twilio's full API surface—over 1,800 endpoints across 30+ products
Twilio MCP server exposes tools generating them directly from Twilio's OpenAPI specifications

result.notes: Twilio offers self-serve free tier access with full REST API capabilities. Official MCP server is available. Large API surface (1400+ endpoints) is manageable via MCP's service/tag filtering.
